definitions.gloss: letter of resignation; written request to resign
definitions.explanation: A formal document in which an employee or official asks to be allowed to leave their post. Phrased as a request for permission, reflecting that the resignation must be accepted by a superior.

examples.japanese: {辞職願|じしょくねがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I submitted a letter of resignation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{辞職願|じしょくねがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}した→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I handed in my letter of resignation to the department head.

examples.japanese: ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧のうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{辞職願|じしょくねがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: Taking responsibility, he wrote his letter of resignation that very day.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{辞職|じしょく}→辞職：06157_jishoku⟧ (resignation) plus {願|ねがい} (request). The {願|ねがい} ending frames it as asking permission to resign, used when the resignation is subject to approval.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {辞職願|じしょくねがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to submit a resignation letter
- {辞職願|じしょくねがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to hand in a resignation letter
- {辞職願|じしょくねがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受理|じゅり}→受理：12032_juri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to accept a resignation letter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{退職願|たいしょくねがい}→退職願：28562_taishokunegai⟧: letter of resignation — used for ordinary employees leaving a company
- ⟦{辞表|じひょう}→辞表：27086_jihyou⟧: letter of resignation — more formal; typical for executives and officials
